widgets_values:
Click on the top-right corner of the node to open the [subgraph](https://docs.comfy.org/interface/features/subgraph) 
👇

1536 x 864: A strong middle-ground choice for cinematic outputs with good detail, without pushing VRAM too hard

1920 x 1080 might fix the eyes. 5 steps also seems to be fine on euler with this.

Klein-9B (I am now using 4b) has less noisy output out of the box, prompt adherence is good and editing is really good. Variety not bad, LoRA apply well. Ask it to have someone sitting with legs crossed and enjoy your 3-legged human (can be mitigated using more steps/res_2m).

MARKDKBERRY recommend: klein 4b fp8 model (or Q8 gguf) with euler, 5 steps, 1080p its done in 20 seconds and the only let down is the color "pop" is weaker but eyes are fixed at 1080p and detail is better.

Guide: [Subgraph](https://docs.comfy.org/interface/features/subgraph)

## Report issue

Note: please update ComfyUI first ([guide](https://docs.comfy.org/zh-CN/installation/update_comfyui)) and prepare required models. Desktop/Cloud ship stable builds; nightly-supported models may not be included yet, please wait for the next stable release.

- Cannot run / runtime errors: [ComfyUI/issues](https://github.com/comfyanonymous/ComfyUI/issues)
- UI / frontend issues: [ComfyUI_frontend/issues](https://github.com/Comfy-Org/ComfyUI_frontend/issues)
- Workflow issues: [workflow_templates/issues](https://github.com/Comfy-Org/workflow_templates/issues)

MARKDKBERRY.com

I tested the fp8 4B model with settings mentioned and found it to be faster and just as good so will use that. I also tested Q8 gguf model but the fp8 felt more detailed and was faster.

the 4b uses the qwen 3b_4b clip model so locate that from blackforest too. its all quicker and useable for lower VRAM. I am getting 1080p in 20 seconds which is incredible.

# PROMPT:

## to test crowds and faces and color:

**positive**: 

```
A densely packed crowd of hundreds of people standing in a long city street, faces clearly visible from extreme foreground to far distance, strong depth perspective, wide angle 24mm lens, front row ultra sharp detailed faces with pores and skin texture, middle rows slightly softer, far background faces still distinct but small, cinematic depth falloff, vibrant multicultural crowd, neon festival atmosphere, high color saturation, people wearing bright red, cobalt blue, emerald green, yellow, magenta clothing, colorful face paint, glowing LED accessories, warm sunset light mixed with cool cyan and purple neon signs, volumetric light beams, shallow haze in distance, ultra detailed, photorealistic, sharp focus, high dynamic range, natural skin tones, no blur in foreground faces, realistic proportions, detailed eyes
```

**Negative Prompt (important for crowd models)**:

```
distorted faces, melted features, duplicate faces, extra eyes, extra mouths, deformed anatomy, blurry foreground, warped perspective, low detail background, washed out colors, overexposed skin, oversharpened artifacts, flat lighting
```

## Fun retro space models

**positive prompt**:

```
A sexy woman with long hair, in a revealing, body-hugging, shiny, tight space suit, inside a space ship with complex looking dials and equipment. outside the window is the immensity of space.

pay close attention to detailing the eyes

colors: 60 percent monochromatic creamy-pink environment, warm tungsten key light, practical light sources visible in frame.

Style in 1970s retro futurism, analog sci-fi, cassette futurism, practical film set, tungsten lighting, warm color cast, muted blacks, 35mm film, soft highlight bloom, subtle film grain, cinematic realism, low contrast film stock.
```

**negative**:

```
modern lighting, digital sharpness, HDR, oversaturated, cyberpunk neon, clean minimalism, glossy CGI, high contrast, visible studio lighting equipment, bad eyes, low quality eye detail,
```
